plugins.name: gh
plugins.description: GitHub and git workflow skills. /gh:sync moves a checkout to its default branch, fast-forwards it, and prunes branches whose work has already landed. /gh:shepherd merges a repo's auto-merge-enabled dependencies PRs one at a time.

plugins.name: workstreams
plugins.description: Turn a set of GitHub issues into parallel workstreams run by subagents, each ending in a reviewed draft PR. /workstreams:plan proposes streams, stacks, and sizing; /workstreams:run executes them as a self-timed loop.

plugins.name: field-test
plugins.description: Plugin quality assurance. /field-test:run runs a skill under observation and files one reproducible issue per problem; /field-test:harden loops that over a list of repositories and drives each round through fix, review, and merge until the skill is clean.
